paite: Huchih lai in, Sabbath ni in buhlei kantan in Jesu apai hi. Nungzuite agilkial ua, nek ding in buhvuite akhiak uhi.
heading: Sabbath Ni Thu A Dotna / (Mar 2.23-28; Luk 6.1-5)
english: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

paite: Pharisaite'n huai amuh un, akiang ah, "En dih, na nungzuite'n Sabbath ni in hihsiang lou ahih uh," achi uhi.
english: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "David in agilkial lai a alawmte toh athilhih uh na sim kei ua hia?
english: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:

paite: Huchi a Pathian inn a alut a, amah leh alawmte'n nek siang louh, siampute kia nek siang tanghou koihtuam anek thu uh?
english: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

paite: Ahihkeileh Sabbath ni in tempul a siampu omte'n Sabbath ni abohsiat un leng siamtang in a-om uh chih Dan thu na sim kei ua hia?
english: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?

paite: Huchi ahih ngalleh, tempul sang a thupizaw hiai ah a-om chih ka hon hilh ahi.
english: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

paite: Himahleh 'kithoihna deih lou in, zahngaihna ka deih' chih a-omdan na thei hi le uchin, mi siamtangte siam louh tangsak lou ding hi ve uchin.
english: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.

paite: Mihing Tapa zaw Sabbath' Toupa ahi," achi hi.
english: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

paite: Huan huai a kipan apai a, asinagogte uah ava lut hi.
heading: Khutzaw Hihdamna / (Mar 3.1-6; Luk 6.6-11)
english: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.

paite: Ngai dih, mi khat khutzaw ana om a, amah ahektheihna ding un, "Sabbath ni a hihdam asiang hia?" chi in Jesu adong uhi.
english: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Noute lak ah kuapeuh in belam khat nei unla, Sabbath ni in kokhuk ah ke taleh kua ahia len a kaikhe lou ding?
english: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?

paite: Belam khat sang in mihing khat bangchi lel a manphazaw ahia? Huaiziak in Sabbath ni in hihhoih asiang hi,” achi hi.
english: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

paite: Huai zoh in, huai mi kiang ah, "Na khut zan in," achi a, huchi in azan a, alangkhat bang in adamsiangta hi.
english: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

paite: Pharisaite bel apawt ua, amah ahihlup theihdan ding uh ngaihtuah in akihou uhi.
english: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

paite: Jesu'n huai thu atheih in huai mun a kipan in akihemmang hi. Himahleh mi tampi in amah azui ua, adamloute uh ana hihdam vek hi.
heading: Pathian Sikha Tel
english: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

paite: Atanchin genthang het lou ding in akiang uah achi hi.
english: and commanded them that they should not make him known,

paite: Huai zawlnei Isai thugenkholh tangtunna ding ahi zaw hi;
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

paite: "En dih, ka sikha ka tel, ka deihtak, ka lungsim in apahtak mahmah, atung ah ka Kha ka koih dia, huchi in Zentelte kiang ah dik a vaihawmna apuangkhe ding hi;
english: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

paite: Asel kei ding a, akikou sam kei ding, kongzing ah kuamah in a-aw aza kei ding uh.
english: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

paite: Dik a vaihawmna avualzohsak mateng sialluang kigawpsa ahihtankhe kei ding a, meivak kuang liakliak ahihmit sam kei ding hi.
english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

paite: Amah min ah Zentelte'n lametna angah ding uh," achi hi.
english: In his name, the nations will hope.”

paite: Huchih lai in dawimat mittaw pau thei lou khat akiang ah hon pi ua; ama'n ahihdam a, pau thei lou hong pau in, ahon mutheita hi.
heading: Setan Panpihna Hilou Pathian Nasep / (Mar 3.20-30; Luk 11.21-23)
english: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

paite: Huchi in mipi tengteng in lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Hiai mipa, David Tapa hilou ahi maw?" achi uhi.
english: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

paite: Himahleh Pharisaite'n huai azak phet un, "Hiai mi'n dawite kumpipa, Beelzibul ziak lou in dawite adelhkhe kei ding," achi uhi.
english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

paite: Jesu'n amaute ngaihtuahte athei a, akiang uah, "Koi gam leng amah kidou amangthang nak; koi khua hiam, inkuan khat leng amah kidou, akhosuak kei ding hi.
english: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

paite: Setan in Setan mah adelhkhiak in amah-le-amah kidou hi ding ahi a; agam bangchi in adingh dia le?
english: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

paite: Huan kei Beelzibul ziak a dawite delhkhia ka hihleh, na tate un kua ziak in ahia adelhkhiak uh? Huaiziak in amaute noute tung a thukhen mite ahi ding uhi.
english: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

paite: Himahleh, ke'n Pathian Kha ziak a dawite delhkhia ka na hihleh, Pathian lalgam na kiang uah hong tungta ahi ding hi.
english: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

paite: "Huchi ahih kei ngal in, mi'n mihat agak masak phot keileh bangchi in ahia mihat inn alut a, asum alaksak theih ding? Huai nung in a-inn alok mai ding hi.
english: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

paite: "Kuapeuh kei lam a pang lou, hon dou ahi; kuapeuh hon lakkhawmpih lou in athehzak ahi.
english: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

paite: Huaiziak in ka hon hilh ahi, mi akhelhna chiteng uah leh Pathian agensiatna chiteng uh ngaihdam ahi ding ua; Kha hilhial agensiatna ngaihdamsak ahi kei ding hi.
english: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

paite: Kuapeuh Mihing Tapa kalh, akalhna uh ngaihdamsak ahi ding; kuapeuh Kha Siangthou hilhial kalh zaw huai akalhna uh, tu damsung leh hun hong tung ding ah leng, ngaihdam ahi kei ding," achi hi.
english: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.

paite: "Sing hoih agah leng ahoih na chih kei ngal uleh, sing sia agah leng asia, chi vanglak un; sing agah a akitheih ziak in.
heading: Sing Leh Agah / (Luk 6.43-45)
english: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

paite: Nou gul suante aw, nou gilou napi in bangchi in ahia thuhoih na gen theih ding uh? Lungtang a dim val kam in agen zel hi.
english: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

paite: Mihoih in agoubawm hoih a kipan thil hoihte alakhia a, migilou in agoubawm hoih lou a kipan thil hoih lou alakhe zel hi.
english: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

paite: "Huan ka hon hilh ahi. Mite'n thugina lou agen peuhmah uh huai thu tanchin mah vaihawm ni chiang in agen ding uhi.
english: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

paite: Na thu in siam ahon tangsak ding a, na thu mah in siam louh ahon tangsak ding hi," achi hi.
english: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

paite: Huai lai in laigelhmite leh Pharisaite lak a mi kuate hiam in amah ahoupih ua akiang ah, "Heutupa, nang a kipan chiamtehna muh ka ut uh," achi uhi.
heading: Chiamtehna Ngetna / (Mar 8.11-12; Luk 11.29-32)
english: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Khang gilou leh angkawmte'n chiamtehna azong ua, himahleh zawlnei Jonah chiamtehna lou ngal akiang uah chiamtehna piak ahi kei ding hi.
english: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

paite: Ngapi gilsung a Jonah ni thum leh zan thum a-om bang in, Mihing Tapa ni thum leh zan thum lei gilsung ah a-om sam ding hi.
english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

paite: Nineveh khomite thukhen ni chiang in hiai khangte kiang ah adingh sam ding ua, siam louh atangsak ding uh. Jonah thugen ziak in akisik ua; ngai dih ua, Jonah sang a thupizaw hiai ah a-om hi.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

paite: Thukhen ni chiang in hiai khangte kiang ah simlam kumpinu athou ding a, siam louh atangsak ding hi, Solomon pilna ngaikhe ding in kawlmong a kipan ahong pai ngal a; ngai dih ua, hiai ah Solomon sang a thupizawa-om hi!
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

paite: "Huan mihing sung a kipan a dawi nin pawt in, khawlna zong in tui omlouhna mun ah avakvak a, amu kei hi.
heading: Akim Lou A Kibawl Lauhuaina / (Luk 11.24-26)
english: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.

paite: Huan 'ka pawtna inn mah ah ka kik nawn mai ding,' achi a; ava tunleh ahawm a zephoihsa in ava mu hi.
english: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

paite: Huaitak in ava pai a, amah sang a gilouzaw dawi dang sagih ahon pi a, huai mi sung ah alut ua, atengta uhi; huai mihing omdan nanung amasa sang in ahong hoih kei zaw hi. Tua bang mah in, hiai khang giloutakte tung ah ahong om ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

paite: Mipite kiang a thu agen lai in ngai dih, amah houpih tum in inpua ah anu leh a-unaute adingh uhi.
heading: Jesu Nu Leh Asanggamte / (Mar 3.31-35; Luk 8.19-21)
english: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

paite: Mi khat in akiang ah, "Ngai dih, na nu leh na unaute nang hon houpih tum in inpua ah adingh nilouh uh," achi hi.
english: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

paite: Ama'n ahilhpa kiang ah, "Ka nu kua ahia? Ka unaute leng kuate ahi ua?" chi in adawng hi.
english: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

paite: Huan nungzuite lam a akhut zan in, "En un, ka nu leh ka unaute;
english: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

paite: kuapeuh ka Pa van a om deihlam hih phot ka unaupa leh ka unaunu leh ka nu ahi uh," achi hi.
english: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”
